ObstacleManager::Create performs common actor initialization and Add(...,true)/OnSpawn before returning child handle.

operations: Return early if child handle already in mChildren.
Append child handle preserving insertion order.
Resolve child through ObstacleManager handle table; if found set child.mParent=parent.mHandle.

Unless parent original data Name is HeroStart, set child byte+0x38 to1 and light byte+0x38 to1 when light exists. This is the byte populated from SortMode by InitThing; enum name for1 not recovered here.
ClearGridRecord virtual slot0x148, then register grid range from existing integer rectangle with original grid origin/shift/clamps.
Mark DrawGridManager update using child entity.
Queue UseableManager update if Interact exists.
does_not: modify child world XY, Z, body scale, angle, or generic attach offset

generic_dynamic_attachment_separate_path.evidence_kind: matching-PDB bounded static disassembly; not new REA decompilation
attach_operation: Remove own Thing.mId from previous live generic parent attachment-ID list.
Assign new parent Entity(pointer and entity-ID), append own Thing.mId to new parent attachment list.
generic_dynamic_attachment_separate_path.on_attached_to_moved: If parent Entity is alive and pointer exists, candidateXY=parent.GetLocation()+mAttachOffset. Otherwise candidateXY=current own mLocation. Call virtual SetLocation(candidateXY,false), then MarkSortScoreChanged. No rotation/scale/Z arithmetic in this bounded routine.
generic_dynamic_attachment_separate_path.location_change_propagation: Obstacle.SetLocation updates own XY, offsets polygon by delta, tracks fractional integer-rectangle error, then resolves generic mAttachmentIds and invokes each OnAttachedToMoved; updates grid/draw state. It iterates Thing+0x178, not structural Obstacle.mChildren+0x648.
generic_dynamic_attachment_separate_path.unresolved: Do not assume generic dynamic attachment semantics define structural map-child movement; structural-tree per-update behavior outside these bounded routines remains untraced.

initial_vs_update_boundary.initial: Run common initialization once on fresh/defaulted actor with resolved native defaults and native supplied XY, then structural graph linking in native creation/callback order.
initial_vs_update_boundary.update: Later SetLocation, generic OnAttachedToMoved, and dirty/grid/sort propagation operate initialized state. They are not substitutes for creation and do not justify rerunning cumulative InitMapThing.
initial_vs_update_boundary.rendering: HDS3/v5 baked geometry and source coordinates remain preserved; this contract adds actor semantics, not scene regeneration.

genuine_creation_remaining_prerequisites: Entity and obstacle/unit handle allocation, lifetime/aliveness and manager identity must be established, not merely map IDs registered.
Reproduce native Defaults and BodyComponent constructor baseline before cumulative transformations.
Resolved definition defaults beyond verified TriggerOnSpawn/PlayerControlled must remain explicit unknowns.
Correct RNG stream/seed/order is required for source MinScale/MaxScale placements.
Complete InitPhysics, geometry, collision, life, light/occluder, interactions and unit-specific data must be initialized or reported unsupported.
GroupManager top-level enumeration and callbacks must see incrementally created actors; full-map pre-registration changes query visibility.
OnSpawn child callback precedes structural parent linkage and grandchildren; preserve native observations and definition gates.
Structural-tree dynamic movement/angle/Z propagation is not fully traced by this bounded contract.

session_lifecycle.ownership: Parent-owned actor-init batch; this worker did not open or operate a session.
